steps.line: POST received on the webhook, header token checked, batch run started
prospect file read off disk, one CSV, no call to Apollo
20 rows out of the CSV, header row read first
13 of the 13 mapped columns resolved against Apollo's header strings, description included
20 prospects normalized, each address cut down to a masked form at the boundary
prospect 1 of 20, one per pass
draft requested, the prospect's row as the only context...
draft back in 1.222s, 316 tokens, US$0.000079
four rules: 41 words against 25 to 60, no stock phrase, company named, nothing copied. Cleared
row written as pending, before the sender is touched
destination overridden to the lab inbox, the prospect address is never the target
message handed to the lab mailbox...
Gmail answered with a message id in 0.615s, row flips to sent
1s pause before the next prospect...
prospect 2 of 20
draft back in 1.205s, 41 words, cleared
persisted, then handed to Gmail, message id back in 2.397s
prospects 3 to 19: the same path each time, one prospect per pass, 1s apart
17 more drafts cleared on the first pass (31 to 44 words), 17 more message ids back
prospect 20 of 20, the last one
draft back in 1.342s, 41 words, cleared
handed to Gmail, message id back in 0.517s
list exhausted, the loop ends
20 sourced, 20 drafted, 20 cleared the gate on the first pass, 20 handed to the lab mailbox. 6,414 tokens, US$0.001601. Done in 57.619s
